event: You swim out to Ghost-Eye's body; it floats low in the channel, drifting north.

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye's body floats low in the channel and drifts slowly north round the island.

event: Up close it's huge, its grey-green scales scarred pale along the flank.

memory.fact: Up close Ghost-Eye is huge, its grey-green scales scarred pale along the flank.

event: You will water and earth into its skull; within a minute the milky eye comes free, a clouded pearl.

changes.note: Nala plucks Ghost-Eye's milky eye and keeps it

memory.fact: In a dead body the water answers again, slow and heavy; plucking an eye or ears with it is easy.
Ghost-Eye's milky eye, plucked, is a hard pearl of clouded crystal.
One weave plucks the eye in about a minute; ears need a water disc; together about two minutes.

event: A thin water disc takes both ears; you tuck eye and ears into your pack.

changes.note: Nala cuts both of Ghost-Eye's ears free and packs them

memory.fact: On day 3 Nala took Ghost-Eye's milky eye and both its ears, and carries them in her pack.

event: You swim on across the channel and climb out onto the island's east shore.
Under the pines lie the pack's flattened beds and a reek of wolf.

memory.fact: Under the pines on the island's east shore lie the pack's flattened beds and a reek of wolf.

event: You walk on through the pines, scanning for wolves; the island is empty and quiet.

memory.fact: At about 13:50 on day 3 the pine island held no wolves.
No wolf is left on the island; Four, Five and Six are gone west with the pups into the deep fen.

event: In the island's middle a den mouth gapes under a great drowned pine, ringed with old gnawed bones.

memory.fact: The pack's den mouth gapes under the roots of a great drowned pine in the pine island's middle.

event: Among the bones, half in the mud, lie a reed-cutter's knife and a tin token of Sallow Hythe.

memory.fact: The pack's den under the pines holds bones, and a reed-cutter's knife and tin token of Sallow Hythe.

event: The token is stamped with a reed sheaf and a name, Ewan Dell; you slip it into your pack for proof.

changes.note: Nala takes Ewan Dell's tin token from the den for proof
Her mana comes back through the swim and the island search
She catches her breath on the island after the fight

memory.fact: The den holds one tin token, stamped with a reed sheaf and the name Ewan Dell.
Ewan Dell was one of the two Sallow Hythe reed-cutters Ghost-Eye's pack killed this summer.

event: Palm to the ground at the den mouth, you weave earth and air into a ripple to feel for wolves.

changes.note: The earth-and-air ripple costs 10 mana

memory.fact: An earth-and-air ripple feels hollows and moving air sharply, but living bodies only faintly.

event: Three linked hollows lie under the roots, every one empty and still.

memory.fact: The pine den is three linked hollows under the roots, empty of any living thing.

event: Beside the den, down in the drowned pine's roots, the ripple finds two small hard, cold knots.

memory.fact: The earth-and-air ripple feels two small hard, cold knots in the drowned pine roots beside the den.

event: Curious, you kneel and reach into the root-bound soil with an earth working; it draws them up.

changes.note: The earth working that draws the knots up costs 10 mana

memory.fact: Nala drew the two cold knots up from the drowned pine's root-bound soil with an earth working.
An earth working draws the two knots out of the root-bound soil in about a minute; an easy act.
Mana crystals grow in the island's drowned pine roots; a careful search there finds two small ones.

event: Two pale blue crystals, each a thumb-joint long, cold to hold and glowing faintly in the shade.

memory.fact: The two knots are thumb-joint crystals, pale blue, cold, faintly aglow in shade.
A small mana crystal is a thumb-joint of pale blue crystal, cold to hold and faintly aglow in shade.

event: Held in your palm, each hums faintly against the mana inside you.

memory.fact: Held, the two pale blue crystals hum faintly against Nala's mana.
Held in hand, a mana crystal hums faintly against anyone with a mana reserve.

event: You tuck the two crystals into your pack beside the eye, the ears and the token.

memory.fact: Nala carries the two pale blue crystals and Ewan Dell's tin token in her pack.

event: You swim back to the marsh and set out east for Fenwatch, a bath, a meal and a bed.
You skim the wet stretches on air and water while your mana holds, and wade the rest.
The fen lies quiet all through the long afternoon.

changes.note: The long wade back east tires her

memory.fact: No wolf crosses her path between the pine island and Fenwatch on day 3.

event: At half past four you come up out of the reeds at the fen edge by the Greyback, caked in muck.

changes.note: Her mana returns over the afternoon's wade, net of her skimming

event: Rowan Coalby waits there, soot-dark and broad, with Sedge at his heel.

memory.fact: At 16:30 on day 3 Rowan and Sedge met Nala at the fen edge by the Greyback.
Rowan Coalby is broad and soot-dark, and his words catch when he speaks.

event: Sedge's crest bristles; it whines and backs away from you, nose working at your pack.

memory.fact: Sedge bristles and whines at Ghost-Eye's scent on Nala's pack, and will not come near her.

event: Rowan's words catch: "Th-that howl, after noon. Was it... is it..."

memory.fact: Rowan, stammering, asked Nala about the howl he heard from the fen after noon.

event: "Yep! Mission complete!" Ghost-Eye and the highest-level ones are dead. "Want to see the eye?"

memory.fact: Nala killed Ghost-Eye and its pack's highest-level wolves on day 3; the rest of the pack lives.

event: Rowan goes still, then laughs, a startled bark, and scrubs a sooty hand over his face. "Show me."

memory.fact: Told Ghost-Eye is dead, Rowan goes quiet, then laughs; Sedge's name is cleared for good.

event: You hold the milky eye out on your palm; Sedge flattens its crest and backs off, growling low.

memory.fact: Rowan wants to see the eye; at the sight of it Sedge flattens its crest and backs off, growling low.

event: "A d-drake-pearl. An old alpha's eye goes to that. Alchemists in Wendlow pay several gold."

memory.fact: Rowan knows an old alpha's clouded eye as a drake-pearl, grown of mana, that alchemists prize.
Rowan reckons a drake-pearl fetches several gold from an alchemist in Wendlow.
Ghost-Eye's milky eye is a hard pearl of clouded crystal, mana-grown; alchemists would pay well.

event: "But the Hall pays on the head. Only the head. Fen scavengers will have the body in two days."

memory.fact: Rowan warns the Hall pays on the head alone, and fen scavengers will have the body in two days.
Antler Hall pays Ghost-Eye's bounty on the whole head; an eye and ears alone it will not take.

event: "Oh drat. I left it on the island. Come back with me for it and I'll cut you in for a gold."
"I'll c-come. But not tonight." He glances west, where the light is going gold over the reeds.

memory.fact: Rowan agrees to go, but not into the fen by night; he asks to set out at first light on day 4.

event: "After dark the fen belongs to the pack, and worse. I wade too slow. First light tomorrow."

memory.fact: He says the fen after dark belongs to the pack and worse, and he wades too slow to be out by dusk.

event: He shakes his head at the gold: "Sedge's name cleared is p-pay enough."

memory.fact: He refuses her gold, stammering that Sedge's name cleared is pay enough.

event: He'll bring a hatchet, rope and his reed sled; Sedge knows the firm ground, though not the carcass.

memory.fact: He will bring a hatchet, rope and the reed drag-sled he hauls charcoal on.
Sedge will come, uneasy near the carcass, but leads them by the firmest ground.
Rowan says Sedge will come and lead them over the firmest ground.

event: He asks to walk you in and tell the Stag himself that Sedge never killed their stock.

memory.fact: Tonight he offers to walk her in to Fenwatch and tell the Stag Sedge never killed stock.

event: "Sure thing! I wanted a bath tonight anyway." You walk in along the Greyback, Sedge ranging ahead.
Near twenty to six the gate watch bristle at Sedge, spears ready, until Rowan speaks for it.

changes.note: Her mana fills to the top on the walk in

memory.fact: At the gate near 17:40 on day 3, the watch bristles at Sedge until Rowan speaks up for it.

event: The Tarred Stag is full for supper; a stranger in a blue coat and wide hat sits near the fire.

memory.fact: At 17:45 on day 3 the Stag holds Garrick, Agathe, Osric and a score of villagers at supper.

event: Rowan: "Sh-she killed Ghost-Eye. Today. And Sedge n-never took your stock. Not once."

memory.fact: In the Stag Rowan tells the hall, stammering, that Nala killed Ghost-Eye and Sedge never took stock.

event: The hall goes silent; then Garrick bellows, and every mug in the Stag comes up to you.

memory.fact: News that Ghost-Eye is dead fills the Stag by nightfall of day 3; the hall toasts Nala.

event: Agathe lifts her oath against Rowan's beast, and gives him winter shelter inside the palisade.

memory.fact: Hearing it, Agathe lifts her oath against Sedge and grants Rowan winter shelter in the palisade.

event: Garrick claps your shoulder: bath, supper and bed tonight are on the Stag.

memory.fact: For Ghost-Eye's killer Garrick stands the bath, supper and bed that night free.

event: Agathe sits by you: "The head, though. Antler Hall pays on the head alone."

memory.fact: At the Stag Agathe told Nala that Antler Hall pays Ghost-Eye's bounty on the head alone.

event: The stranger in blue sweeps off his hat: "Osric Fenn, pedlar. Two gold for your drake-pearl."

memory.fact: Hearing of a drake-pearl, Osric is first to Nala, offering two gold for it on sight.
Osric Fenn named himself to Nala at the Stag as a pedlar.

event: You set two silver on the table for word of what a drake-pearl is good for; he sweeps them up.

changes.note: Nala pays Osric two silver for what he knows of drake-pearls

memory.fact: Osric takes Nala's two silver gladly; he never turns down coin for talk.

event: "Alchemists grind them into night-sight draughts. A mage can drain one. Burning gold, that is."

memory.fact: Osric says Wendlow alchemists grind drake-pearls into night-sight draughts.
Osric says a mage can drain a drake-pearl like a fat crystal, and calls that burning gold.

event: He keeps what the alchemists pay behind a smile: "Two gold and five silver, then."

memory.fact: Osric won't say what an alchemist pays, and lifts his offer to two gold and five silver.
Osric's two gold is a pedlar's price; a Wendlow alchemist pays about four for the drake-pearl.

event: "Could I make it a focus for my casting? Gold I have plenty." Osric laughs and calls for wine.
"Ilse Varrow in Wendlow sets stones like that for mages, at a rich man's price. Mages swear by them"

memory.fact: Osric knows a Wendlow enchanter, Ilse Varrow, who sets such stones for mages, at a rich man's price.
Osric knows no more of what a pearl focus does than that mages swear by them.
In Wendlow the enchanter Ilse Varrow sets mana-grown stones into rings and rods for mages.

event: He presses no further: his offer stands till he leaves for Wendlow, the morning after next.

memory.fact: Hearing she has gold plenty, Osric laughs, lets his offer stand till he leaves, and presses no more.
Osric leaves Fenwatch for Wendlow on the morning of day 5.

event: Garrick heats the back-room tub, his treat; you soak the fen off, then eat a hot supper, also free.

memory.fact: He heats water for a wooden tub in the back room; a hot bath costs two copper.

event: You sleep the night through in a Stag bed and wake rested.

changes.note: A night's sleep in a Stag bed restores her

event: About five, before first light, Rowan waits at his charcoal mounds with sled, rope, hatchet, Sedge.

memory.fact: At first light, about 5:00 on day 4, Rowan waits by his charcoal mounds with sled, rope and Sedge.

event: You wade into the Greyfen, Sedge leading on firm going; the pack's tracks run west; all is quiet.

memory.fact: No wolf crosses them wading out on day 4; the pack's fresh tracks run west, away from the island.
Under Sedge's lead, the wade out on day 4 keeps to firm going and is uneventful.

event: Five hours of wading and hauling the sled bring you to the pine island near ten.

memory.fact: Wading with Rowan and a sled, the pine island is five hours from the fen edge.

event: Ghost-Eye's body lies snagged in the north-bank reeds; scavengers have fed, but the head is whole.

memory.fact: On day 4 Ghost-Eye's body lies snagged in reeds on the pine island's north bank, half out of water.
By dawn of day 4 scavengers have fed on Ghost-Eye's body, but its head is still whole.

event: Two turtles broad as cart wheels are tearing at its haunches.

memory.fact: Near 10:00 on day 4 two Mire Snappers are tearing at Ghost-Eye's haunches.
Mire Snappers are fen turtles as broad as cart wheels.

event: From the marsh across the channel, the snappers are about thirty-five yards off.

memory.fact: From the marsh across the channel, the snappers on Ghost-Eye's body are about 35 yards off.

event: Rowan holds Sedge back on the marsh, Sedge barking at the turtles.

memory.fact: While Nala shoots the snappers, Rowan holds Sedge back on the marsh, barking at them.

event: You spin a grooved slug and send it at the nearer snapper's bobbing head.

changes.note: A grooved slug flies and is not picked up again
A spun slug costs the Weave's 10 mana

memory.fact: A Mire Snapper's head, out and tearing at meat, wards 1; a slug pierces that to nothing.

event: It punches clean through the head as the snapper tears at the meat; it jerks back, badly hurt.

changes.note: Her slug punches through the snapper's head

event: At the crack the second snapper pulls its head in, slides for deep water and is gone under.

memory.fact: At the first slug, the other snapper pulls in its head and slides at once for deep water.
The second Mire Snapper went under unhurt and stays down.

event: The hurt one lumbers for the channel; your second slug slams into its shell, and it keeps going.

changes.note: A grooved slug flies and is not picked up again
A second spun slug costs 10 mana
Her second slug cracks into the snapper's shell

event: Your third strikes as it reaches deep water; the snapper goes still and sinks out of reach.

changes.note: A grooved slug flies and is not picked up again
A third spun slug costs 10 mana
Her third slug kills the snapper as it reaches deep water

memory.fact: About 10:02 on day 4 Nala's three slugs killed one Mire Snapper; it sank in the channel.
The dead Mire Snapper lies sunk in the channel by Ghost-Eye's reeds, too deep to reach by hand.
By 10:02 on day 4 Ghost-Eye's body lies free of scavengers in the reeds, its head whole.

event: [Foe Eliminated! Experience Gained!] [Level up! Nala has reached Level 8.]

changes.note: Her marks reach the next level and begin again

memory.fact: Nala reached Level 8 on day 4 at the pine island.

event: [Strength +2. Dexterity +2. Vigor +2. Attunement +4. Luck +1.]

changes.note: The snapper's kill raises Nala to Level 8
Level 8 grants +2 Strength
Level 8 grants +2 Dexterity
Level 8 grants +2 Vigor
Level 8 grants +4 Attunement
Level 8 grants +1 Luck
Level 8 lifts her greatest health by 5
Attunement 82 lifts her greatest mana to four times it
Vigor 23 lifts her greatest stamina to 72
The level-up fills the new health
The level-up lifts her stamina

event: Rowan swims the thirty yards slowly, chin high, hatchet in his belt; Sedge surges across beside him.

changes.note: Swimming the channel tires her

memory.fact: Rowan swims the 30-yard channel slowly, hatchet in his belt; Sedge swims it strongly.

event: You cross with them, your eyes on the dark water where the live snapper went under.
The water stays flat; the reeds and the marsh behind stand empty of anything moving.

memory.fact: Nothing dangerous showed while they took Ghost-Eye's head on day 4.

event: On the north bank Sedge hangs back ten yards from the body, hackles up, and comes no closer.

memory.fact: On day 4 Sedge hung back ten yards from Ghost-Eye's body, hackles up, and came no closer.

event: Rowan sets his hatchet to the neck while you keep watch; in ten minutes the great head comes free.

changes.note: Her mana comes back to the top while Rowan works

event: Rowan ropes it; you swim it back to the sled on the marsh side, and he lashes it on.

changes.note: Swimming the head back and hauling the sled tire her

memory.fact: Rowan leaves the sled on the marsh side and ropes the head back across the channel to it.
On day 4 Rowan took Ghost-Eye's head off in about ten minutes and lashed it to his sled.

event: Behind you the dead snapper lies on the channel bed, its shell out of reach.
You turn the sled for the village, you and Rowan trading the rope as the hours wear on.
The fen lets you pass; the long haul home goes quiet but for the drag of the sled through sedge.

memory.fact: No beast troubles the haul home on day 4.

event: About four you reach the fen edge and drag the sled up past the Greyback onto the track.

memory.fact: Hauling the head back on the sled, they reach the fen edge about 16:00 on day 4.
On day 4 Nala and Rowan hauled Ghost-Eye's head out of the Greyfen unharmed by about 16:00.

event: About five you bring it through Fenwatch's west gate.

memory.fact: Hauling the sled on from the fen edge, they reach Fenwatch's gate about 17:00 on day 4.

event: Half the village crowds the green to see the head: Hessa, Tobin, Agathe, Garrick and Osric too.

memory.fact: At 17:00 on day 4 half the village crowds the green to see Ghost-Eye's head on Rowan's sled.
Hessa, Tobin, Agathe, Garrick and Osric are all on the green when the head comes in.

event: Hessa looks the head over a long while: "I hadn't thought to see you back."

memory.fact: Hessa looks the head over a long while, then tells Nala plainly she had not thought to see her back.

event: "Salt it tonight, or it's past the Hall's taking within a week."

memory.fact: Hessa tells Nala to salt the head tonight, or it will be past the Hall's taking within a week.

event: Tobin pushes through the crowd: "Take me with you to Wendlow. Please."

memory.fact: Seeing the head, Tobin begs Nala to take him to Wendlow; Hessa says nothing either way.

event: "How far to Wendlow again? I'd love this turned in and paid for before it stinks."
"Three days east on the east road," Hessa says. "By cart or on foot, much the same. Two on a horse."

memory.fact: Hessa tells Nala Wendlow is three days east by cart on the east road, two by a good horse.
On foot the east road to Wendlow is also about three days, much as the cart.
Beyond Fenwatch the track becomes the east road, which runs to Wendlow in about three days by cart.

event: Tobin hears a yes and grins; Hessa: the boy goes only if you say so plainly.

memory.fact: Tobin takes her question as a yes and grins; Hessa says he goes only if Nala says so plainly.

event: Garrick: salt's four copper a sack; bring the head to the back room, an hour's work tonight.

memory.fact: Garrick sells a sack of salt for four copper; packing the head in it takes about an hour.
Garrick offers his salt and a hand packing the head in the Stag's back room tonight.

event: Osric: he leaves for Wendlow at dawn by cart; ride as his guard, and you and your head go free.

memory.fact: Osric offers Nala free passage to Wendlow on his cart at dawn on day 5, if she rides as its guard.

event: "Sure, I don't care who comes. Let's pack it now and go with Osric in the morning."
Hessa: "Plain enough. You can go." Tobin whoops and is off at a run, shouting for his mother.

memory.fact: Hessa takes 'I don't care who comes' as plain enough, and lets Tobin go to Wendlow with Nala.
Let go to Wendlow, Tobin whoops and runs off across the green shouting for his mother.

event: Osric: his cart leaves the Stag at five; Voss's men have robbed carts on the east road this summer.

memory.fact: Osric's mule cart leaves the Stag at 5:00 on day 5; guards walk beside or sit the tailboard.
Osric wants a guard because Harl Voss's men have robbed carts on the east road this summer.

event: You count four copper into Garrick's broad palm for a sack of salt.

changes.note: Nala buys a sack of salt from Garrick for four copper

event: In the back room you two pack the head in salt; one sack does it, and a little after six it's done.

memory.fact: One sack of salt packs Ghost-Eye's head.
Nala and Garrick packed Ghost-Eye's head in salt in about an hour on the evening of day 4.
Packed in salt in a tarred cask, Ghost-Eye's head is ready by about 18:15 on day 4.

event: Bet Ashdown, reed-weaver, Tobin's mother, sets his bag down: "Will you bring him home whole?"

memory.fact: That evening Tobin's mother Bet packs him a bag and asks Nala to bring him home whole.
Tobin's mother is Bet Ashdown, a reed-weaver.

event: Garrick: bed and supper tonight is two silver; the free night was last night.

memory.fact: Garrick charges two silver for a bed and supper at the Stag on day 4; his free night was day 3.

event: "He'll be safe enough as long as he's with me. If he runs off on his own, that's on him."
Bet nods, tight-lipped: "He never ran from anything but chores." Tobin goes red to the ears.

memory.fact: Bet nods, tight-lipped, and says Tobin never ran from anything but chores; Tobin goes red.

event: You pay two silver for bed and supper and two copper for a bath, soak, and sleep a quiet night.

changes.note: Nala pays Garrick two silver for bed and supper and two copper for a bath

memory.fact: On day 4 Nala's bath is not free; Garrick takes his usual two copper for it.
The night of day 4 at Fenwatch passes quiet, and the cart leaves on time with no hitch.

event: At five Osric's mule cart stands before the Stag, the salted head stowed aboard in a tarred cask.

changes.note: A night's sleep at the Stag restores her

memory.fact: Ghost-Eye's head travels in a tarred cask, salt packed round it to the lid.

event: At the gate Rowan and Sedge see you off; Sedge, for once, stretches out and sniffs your hand.

memory.fact: At dawn on day 5 Rowan and Sedge come to the gate to see Nala off; Sedge, for once, sniffs her hand.

event: Hessa hands Tobin a full quiver and gives him one curt nod.

memory.fact: At the gate at dawn on day 5 Hessa gives Tobin a full quiver and one curt nod.

event: The cart rolls out on time; the east road climbs out of the fen country into quiet pine forest.

memory.fact: Day 5's road climbs out of the fen country into pine forest, quiet until the quarry.

event: About three, seventeen miles out, the road bends past an old stone pit: Cutter's Quarry.

memory.fact: Cutter's Quarry lies by the road seventeen miles east of Fenwatch; the cart reaches it about 15:00.
Cutter's Quarry is an old stone pit beside the east road, a day east of Fenwatch.

event: A grey-bearded, scar-lipped man with axe and shield bars the road: five men and a leashed Drakewolf.

memory.fact: Five men and a leashed Drakewolf in a spiked collar stand with Voss at the quarry.

event: "Voss," Osric calls, easy as a neighbour, and pays the silver toll without fuss.

memory.fact: At the quarry a big grey-bearded, scar-lipped man with axe and shield, hailed Voss, bars the road.
Osric pays Voss the silver toll without fuss, as he always has.

event: Voss looks you over and laughs: "This the best guard you could hire, Osric?"

memory.fact: Voss laughed at Osric for hiring so small a guard.
Voss reads Nala as Level 8 and laughs at Osric hiring so small a guard.

event: His eye falls on the tarred cask: "And what's in that?"

memory.fact: Voss's eye falls on the tarred cask, and he asks what it holds.

event: You will earth and air: a grooved slug spins up to a whine, an air ward held ready beside it.

memory.fact: At the roadblock Voss stands 8 yards from Nala, his five men 6 to 12 yards, Crow 35 in the trees.

event: Your guided slug cracks into the steel cap above Voss's brow and snaps his head back; blood runs.

changes.note: A grooved slug flies and is not picked up again
The guided slug costs 10 mana
Raising the air ward costs 10 mana
Her slug cracks into Voss's steel cap

memory.fact: Nala's first slug struck Voss in the head; bleeding, shield up, he charges her with axe high.
Nala's first slug struck Voss in the head; bleeding, shield up, he charges her with axe high.
Voss wears a steel cap; Nala's first slug cracked into it above his brow.
Voss wears a steel cap; Nala's first slug cracked into it above his brow.

event: He stays up, shield high, and charges with a roar; at the crack Osric dives under his cart.

memory.fact: Osric dove under his cart at Nala's first slug.

event: Someone slips the Drakewolf's leash; its jaws close on your forearm and drag you down onto the road.

changes.note: The crew's Drakewolf bites her forearm and drags her down

memory.fact: The crew's Drakewolf dragged Nala down on the road, jaws locked on her forearm.
The crew's Drakewolf dragged Nala down on the road, jaws locked on her forearm.

event: Two of the five raise crossbows; the other three draw blades and come on.

changes.note: Thrown down on the road, she strains against the wolf

memory.fact: At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.
At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.
At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.
At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.
At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.
At her first slug two of the five raised crossbows and three drew blades and closed.

event: Flat on your back, you fling fire and air out before you in a fan to swallow wolf, Voss and men.

changes.note: The fire burst costs 30 mana

event: Flame roars ten yards in a half-circle; you bend it off your own arm, and it licks past you.

memory.fact: Flat on the road, Nala bent her fire burst off her own arm, and it licked past and spared her.

event: The Drakewolf yelps, lets go of your arm and bolts, its fur smoking.

memory.fact: Burned, the crew Drakewolf let go Nala's arm and bolted, smoking.
Burned, the crew Drakewolf let go Nala's arm and bolted, smoking.

event: All three blademen catch alight; their blades clatter down as they beat at the flames.

changes.note: Her fire burst sets the blademan alight
Her fire burst sets the blademan alight
Her fire burst sets the blademan alight

memory.fact: Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.
Nala's fire burst set three blademen alight; they dropped their blades and ran.

event: Voss comes on through the fire behind his shield, singed but upright.

changes.note: The burst singes Voss behind his shield

event: Both crossbowmen loose; your ward slaps one aside, but it skips and gashes your hip; the other turns

changes.note: A turned bolt skips off the road and gashes her hip

memory.fact: At the quarry a crossbow bolt her ward slapped aside skipped off the road and gashed Nala's hip.

event: A third bolt hisses from the trees, from someone you never saw; the ward turns that one too.

memory.fact: Nala's air ward turned two crossbow bolts and a third from someone unseen in the trees.

event: You feed the fire hotter; three sharp whistles, and the burning men run for the pit, Voss with them.

changes.note: Feeding the burst twice more costs 60 mana

memory.fact: Voss came on through the fire behind his shield, then at three sharp whistles broke for the pit.
Voss came on through the fire behind his shield, then at three sharp whistles broke for the pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
At three sharp whistles the whole crew broke and ran for the quarry pit.
